question: How does the triadic world-manifestation arise from consciousness?
premises: The abiding state takes the form of knower, known, and knowing.
This state belongs to perfectly full own-consciousness.
The fashioning of the manifold world occurs spontaneously from that consciousness.
inference: The entire triadic manifestation is the spontaneous, constant self-expression of perfectly full consciousness.
plain_english: Such an abiding state, having the form of knower, known, and knowing, is always the spontaneous fashioning of the manifold world by perfectly full own-consciousness.
